title: Khuphela Iividiyo nee-Reels ze-Instagram kwiFowuni nakwi-Laptop
description: Khuphela iividiyo nee-Reels ze-Instagram kwifowuni okanye kwi-laptop ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Kopa ilinki, uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save, ukhethe.
photo2Caption: Ncamathisela ilinki ye-Reels kwi-I Need Save.
body:
Wakhe wafumana i-Reels ehlekisayo, isifundo sokupheka, okanye ividiyo ekhuthazayo ofuna ukuyibukela kwakhona kamva ngaphandle kokuyikhangela kwakhona? Iindaba ezimnandi kukuba ungakhuphela iividiyo nee-Reels ze-Instagram ngqo kwi-browser usebenzisa i-I Need Save. Akufuneki ufake i-app, akufuneki ungene, kwaye kulula ngokufanayo kwifowuni nakwi-laptop.

Masijonge amanyathelo, ukhetho lweefayile olukhoyo, nezinto ezimbalwa ekufuneka uzazi phambi kokuba uqale.

Ngowuphi Umxholo we-Instagram Onokukhutshelwa?

I-I Need Save isebenza nokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo kwi-Instagram. Oku kuthetha ukuba iividiyo okanye ii-Reels ezivela kwii-akhawunti ezingatshixwanga udla ngokukwazi ukuzigcina. Ngaphandle kwevidiyo, ungathatha nefoto okanye umfanekiso omncinci wokuthunyelweyo.

Kukho into enye ekufuneka uyazi kwasekuqaleni: i-Instagram ngamanye amaxesha ivimba izicelo okanye ifune ukungena. Xa oko kusenzeka, ukukhuphela kunokungaphumeleli nokuba okuthunyelweyo kuvulelekile. Ngokuqhelekileyo kufuneka nje uzame kwakhona emva kwexeshana.

Indlela Yokukhuphela ii-Reels ze-Instagram kwiFowuni

La manyathelo asebenza kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone.

  1. Vula i-app ye-Instagram uze udlale i-Reels okanye ividiyo ofuna ukuyigcina.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share) kokuthunyelweyo.
  3. Khetha Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser uze uye kwi-ineedsave.com.
  5. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela ukuze kukhawuleze.
  6. Cofa Khuphela, uze ulinde kuvele uluhlu lokhetho.
  7. Khetha umgangatho wevidiyo owufunayo, kwaye ifayile iya kuqala ukukhutshelwa.

Kwezinye iividiyo, iqhosha linokubonisa Iyalungiselela…. Oko kuthetha ukuba ividiyo iqala isetyenzwe, umzekelo ividiyo nesandi sayo ziyadityaniswa. Linda nje, ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ifayile ilungile.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-Instagram kwi-Laptop

Ukuba udla ngokuvula i-Instagram kwikhompyutha, indlela nayo ilula:

  1. Vula i-Instagram kwi-browser uze ucofe okuthunyelweyo kwevidiyo okanye i-Reels oyifunayo.
  2. Kopa ilinki yayo kwimenyu ethi Yabelana okanye kwi-address bar ye-browser.
  3. Vula ithebhu entsha, undwendwele iphepha lokukhuphela le-I Need Save, uze uncamathisele ilinki.
  4. Cofa Khuphela uze ukhethe ukhetho oludingayo.

Okukhutshelweyo kuya kugcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo) kwikhompyutha yakho.

Kutheni i-Browser Ilula Ngakumbi?

Ukukhuphela ngewebhusayithi kuneengenelo ezimbalwa. Akufuneki ufake i-app ethatha indawo yokugcina, akufuneki unike iinkcukacha zokungena, kwaye indlela iyafana kuzo zonke izixhobo. Isayithi ye-I Need Save ikwafumaneka ngeelwimi ezingama-93 kwaye ilandela ngokuzenzekelayo umxholo okhanyayo okanye omnyama wefowuni yakho, ngoko ihlala imnandi ukuyisebenzisa nangaliphi na ixesha. Ngaphandle kwe-Instagram, ungasebenzisa le ndlela inye kwi-TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter), nakwi-Pinterest.

Ukhetho Lweefayile Olukhoyo

Emva kokuba ilinki iqhutywe, uya kubona ukhetho oluninzi. Inani neentlobo zalo zixhomekeke kokuthunyelweyo kokuqala:

  • Ividiyo kwimigangatho eyahlukeneyo, umzekelo 360p, 720p, okanye 1080p.
  • Isandi ngomgangatho wokuqala, okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo. Ilungile ukuba ufuna kuphela ilizwi okanye umculo ongasemva.
  • Ifoto / Umfanekiso omncinci wokuthunyelweyo.

Icebiso: Ukuba indawo yokugcina yefowuni yakho iqala ukugcwala, khetha i-720p. Umfanekiso usacacile kwisikrini sefowuni, kodwa ifayile incinci kune-1080p.

Ukufumana Ividiyo Emva Kokuyikhuphela

Xa ukukhuphela kugqityiwe, nantsi indawo yefayile yakho:

  • I-Android: vula ifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo) nge-app yokulawula iifayile. I-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci phambi kokuba ividiyo ivele apho.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): vula i-app ethi Files, uze ungene kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukudlulisela ividiyo kwi-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo kwi-Files, cofa Share (Yabelana), uze ukhethe Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Ukuba usadidekile ukufumana ifayile, isikhokelo esithi apho iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zikhoyo kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone sicacisa ngokweenkcukacha.

Enye into eya kukwenza ukhululeke: iifayile zidluliselwa ngqo zisuka kwi-Instagram ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save.

Kutheni Ividiyo ye-Instagram Ingakhutshelwa?

Ukuba inkqubo ayiphumeleli, jonga ezi zizathu zinokubakho:

  • Okuthunyelweyo kuvela kwi-akhawunti yabucala. Umxholo wabucala awunakukhutshelwa.
  • Umxholo ubonakala kuphela emva kokungena, okanye uthintelwe kwimimandla ethile.
  • I-Instagram ivimba izicelo okanye ifuna ukungena. Zama kwakhona emva kwexeshana.
  • Ilinki encanyathiselweyo ayiyolinki yokuthunyelweyo, umzekelo ilinki yeprofayile. Yikope kwakhona kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana lokuthunyelweyo.

Hlonipha Umsebenzi Wabadali

Sebenzisa iividiyo ozikhuphelileyo kuphela ukuze kube kokwakho. Ukuba ufuna ukuzipapasha kwakhona, qala ucele imvume kumdali uze ukhankanye igama lakhe ngokucacileyo. Abadali basebenze nzima ukwenza loo mxholo, ngoko ilungelo labo lokushicilela kufuneka lihlonitshwe.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ngaba kufuneka ndingene kwi-Instagram ukuze ndikhuphele?

Hayi. Ncamathisela nje ilinki yokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo kwi-I Need Save ngaphandle kokungena.

Ndingazikhuphela ii-Reels ezivela kwi-akhawunti yabucala?

Hayi. Umxholo ovela kwii-akhawunti zabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, nomxholo othintelwe ngokommandla awunakukhutshelwa. Kuxhaswa kuphela okuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo.

Ndingazigcina iifoto ezivela kokuthunyelweyo kwi-Instagram?

Ewe. Emva kokucofa Khuphela, khetha ukhetho oluthi Ifoto / Umfanekiso omncinci oluvela kuluhlu lokhetho.
